title: Social Media Promotions
description: Schema for _data/promotions.yml — a flat inventory of social media posts.

context.description: Free-form text explaining the post — a link, description, or project reference.

projects.description: Related project page slugs. Uses the same convention as articles.yml.

summary.description: Short inline label for project pages (e.g. 'Project launch').

url.description: Public URL of the post on that platform.

content.description: Full text content of the post.
